name: swim-coach
description: Review pool swims and safely perform scoped local writes or exact-confirmed Garmin publication.

interface.shortDescription: Review and safely update swim training
interface.longDescription: Review authenticated pool swims and goals, queue Garmin activity sync, record feedback, propose workout adaptations, and publish only after an exact-hash confirmation boundary.
defaultPrompt: Use Swim Coach to review my latest swim.
Use Swim Coach to show my swimming goal progress.
Use Swim Coach to explain why my latest swim is missing.
Use Swim Coach to adapt my next swim.
Use Swim Coach to publish my workout to Garmin safely.
Use Swim Coach to record my post-swim feedback.
